description_en: Queries the details of one or more deployment sets
description_zh: 查询一个或多个部署集的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-deployment-sets --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --deployment-set-ids 'ds-bp67acfmxazb4ph0000_,_ds-bp67acfmxazb4pi0000_,_…_ds-bp67acfmxazb4pj0000' --network-type example-string --strategy Availability --deployment-set-name testDeploymentSetName --granularity example-string --domain example-string --type host --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDeploymentSets

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the deployment set. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 部署集所属地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the deployment set list.

Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
部署集列表的页码。

起始值为1。

默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值为50。

默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The IDs of deployment sets. The value can be a JSON array that consists of multiple deployment set IDs in the format of `["ds-xxxxxxxxx", "ds-yyyyyyyyy", … "ds-zzzzzzzzz"]`. A maximum of 100 IDs are supported. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 部署集ID列表。取值可以由多个部署集ID组成一个JSON数组，格式为`["ds-xxxxxxxxx", "ds-yyyyyyyyy", … "ds-zzzzzzzzz"]`。最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
parameters.name: deployment_set_ids

parameters.help_en:
The deployment strategy. Valid values:

Availability: high availability.
AvailabilityGroup: high availability for deployment set groups.
LowLatency: low network latency
parameters.help_zh:
部署策略。取值范围：

Availability：高可用策略。
AvailabilityGroup：部署集组高可用策略。
LowLatency：网络低时延策略
parameters.name: strategy

parameters.help_en: The name of the deployment set. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain characters that are categorized as letter in Unicode, including English letters, Chinese characters, and digits. The name can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 部署集名称。长度为2~128个字符，支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: deployment_set_name

parameters.help_en:
The deployment type. Valid values:
host: physical server
sw: vSwitch
rack: rack

Default value: host
parameters.help_zh:
部署类型。取值范围：
host：物理机
sw：交换机
rack：机架

默认值：host
parameters.name: type

DeploymentSet.description_en: The details of the deployment sets. The value is an array that consists of DeploymentSet objects
DeploymentSet.description_zh: 由DeploymentSet组成的数组格式，返回部署集详细信息

Affinity.description_en: The affinity level of the deployment set

Capacity.description_en: The capacity information of the deployment set at the zone level. The value is an array that consists of Capacity objects. This parameter is returned only when the deployment set contains existing ECS instances
Capacity.description_zh: 由Capacity组成的数组格式。仅当部署集内有存量ECS实例时提供返回结果，返回结果包含部署集可用区维度的容量信息

AvailableAmount.description_en: The number of ECS instances that can be added to the deployment set in the zone
AvailableAmount.description_zh: 该可用区内，还可以加入当前部署集的ECS实例数量

UsedAmount.description_en: The number of ECS instances in the deployment set that belong to the zone
UsedAmount.description_zh: 部署集内属于该可用区的ECS实例数量

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID. Only the zone IDs of existing ECS instances in the deployment set are returned
ZoneId.description_zh: 可用区ID。只返回部署集内存量ECS实例所属的可用区ID

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the deployment set was created

DeploymentSetDescription.description_en: The description of the deployment set

DeploymentSetId.description_en: The ID of the deployment set

DeploymentSetName.description_en: The name of the deployment set

DeploymentStrategy.description_en: The deployment strategy. This response parameter corresponds to the value of the `Strategy` request parameter
DeploymentStrategy.description_zh: 部署策略。该返回值对应请求参数`Strategy`的值

GroupCount.description_en:
The number of groups in the deployment set.

This response parameter takes effect only when the deployment set strategy is set to high availability for deployment set groups (AvailabilityGroup)
GroupCount.description_zh:
部署集中的分组数量。

当部署集策略为部署集组高可用策略（AvailabilityGroup）时，该返回值生效

InstanceAmount.description_en: The number of instances in the deployment set

InstanceId.description_en: The instance IDs of instances in the deployment set

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the deployment set list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the deployment set

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of queried deployment sets
